description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'TermLocalizedTranslation' for migrating taxonomy terms with localized translations, including methods for querying the database, preparing rows, and defining fields and IDs.

classes.name: TermLocalizedTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for localized taxonomy terms in Drupal 7, extending Term and using I18nQueryTrait.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds a database query to retrieve taxonomy term translations with language and property details.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row by overriding language and fetching missing property translations.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines the fields available in the source, including language, name translation, and description translation.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifiers for the source, including language with alias 'lt'.
